description.value: Bae Side is a waterfront restaurant and event venue on the False Creek seawall in Vancouver, operated by Mishree Restaurant Concepts (the team behind Tandoori Flame and Happy Singh Eats) at the former Mahony & Sons location. It serves pan-Asian tapas, fresh salads, and handcrafted cocktails from an indoor-outdoor space with skyline views and a 300+ seat patio. With capacity for up to 600 guests and a dog-friendly patio, it is a substantial stop on one of Vancouver's most popular cycling corridors.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (30 spaces) at 40m; stands (40 spaces) at 40m; stands (16 spaces) at 51m; stands (16 spaces) at 55m; stands (4 spaces) at 96m. Total: 106 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at baesideco.com confirms an active, full-service waterfront restaurant at 601 Stamps Landing in False Creek, Vancouver, operated by Mishree Restaurant Concepts (formerly Mahony & Sons). The navigation menu includes a 'Vegan & Kids' section, confirming vegan options are available. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, etc.) are explicitly mentioned on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name is 'Bae Side' but the website consistently uses 'Bae Side Co' — minor branding discrepancy.
No phone number present in OSM tags or on the website; group bookings contact is email only (falsecreek@mishreeconcepts.com).
The 'Our Story' page notes the venue was previously 'Mahony & Sons False Creek' under new management from Mishree Restaurant Concepts — OSM record may still reflect the old operator in some tags.
